title: Mayon Volcano Ash Advisory May 2 — eruption FL060 EXTD WSW (Himawari-9)
snippet: Tokyo VAAC issued ash advisory at 07:59 UTC based on Himawari-9 satellite data. Eruption at 07:29 UTC on May 2. Volcanic ash not identifiable from satellite data but eruption confirmed. Lava flow lengths: Basud Gully 3.8km (E), Bonga 3.2km (SE), Mi-isi 1.6km (S). SO₂ 2,147 t/day (previous report). Alert Level 3 maintained by PHIVOLCS.
tag_reason: 후속: May 2 분출 이벤트 확인 (Himawari-9 위성 감지). 이전 보고 대비 신규 분출 에피소드 추가. VAAC 화산재 권고 발행.
